dialogues.speaker: Durgar
dialogues.text: Thanks to the blessings of Lesser Lord Kusanali, the newly arrived wood is very sturdy and barely has any quality issues.

dialogues.speaker: Durgar
dialogues.text: Good day. I am the carpenter here. If you need any woodwork done, I'm your guy.

dialogues.speaker: Durgar
dialogues.text: I handle everyone's carpentry needs around here. Fair prices and reliable quality guaranteed.

dialogues.speaker: Durgar
dialogues.text: The newly arrived wood is really something — firm, durable, and has a beautiful texture. If you'd like to let me build you something with this lumber, you'd better make up your mind quick.

dialogues.speaker: Durgar
dialogues.text: This is a blessing from Lesser Lord Kusanali. I must make sure every piece of it is made into quality products.

dialogues.speaker: Durgar
dialogues.text: Goodbye! Come to me if you need any woodworking done!

dialogues.speaker: Durgar
dialogues.text: The fact that Sumeru people are living in a place where trees and flowers flourish instead of struggling amidst barren deserts is all thanks to the kindness of the Lord Kusanali.

dialogues.speaker: Durgar
dialogues.text: Greater Lord Rukkhadevata left roots and nutrients to Sumeru, which have now been inherited and protected by Lesser Lord Kusanali.

dialogues.speaker: Durgar
dialogues.text: So now, all our harvests are born from her mercy.

dialogues.speaker: Durgar
dialogues.text: And since I live by carpentry, which is closely related to trees, I am even more grateful to the Dendro Archon!

dialogues.speaker: Durgar
dialogues.text: The fact that Sumeru people are living in a place where trees and flowers flourish instead of struggling amidst barren deserts is all thanks to the kindness of Lord Kusanali.

dialogues.speaker: Durgar
dialogues.text: She lay down the roots and fertilized the land — all our harvests, whether in the fields or in life, stem from her.

dialogues.speaker: Durgar
dialogues.text: And since carpentry's how I make my living, a trade that's plenty close to the trees, I'm all the more grateful to the Dendro Archon!
